title: 50ft Private Yacht Experience in Miami for 12 people
includes: Bluetooth and speakers to play your own music onboard
Cooler so that you can bring your own drinks
Independent USCG-licensed Captains available for selection.
Captain and Fuel Surcharge - USD 120 per HOUR (Government Charge ) (not included)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Minimum aged allowed is 3 years and above
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Step aboard a stunning 50‑foot luxury yacht and experience Miami the way it was meant to be seen — from the water, in total comfort, with your own private crew. This spacious vessel offers multiple lounging areas, a premium sound system, and plenty of room to relax, celebrate, and enjoy the city’s world‑famous coastline.
Cruise through Biscayne Bay, glide past celebrity mansions on Star Island, and take in panoramic views of the Miami skyline before anchoring at a crystal‑clear sandbar where you can swim, float, and soak up the sun. Perfect for birthdays, bachelorette parties, family outings, or a stylish day on the water, this 50’ yacht delivers an unforgettable Miami experience.
